title: Weak continuity of pull-backs of continuous forms by uniformly convergent, uniformly Lipschitz maps (supplied step 6, B4)
statement: Let m, N' ∈ ℕ, L ≥ 0, and let H_j, H₀ : ℝ^m → ℝ^{N'} (j ∈ ℕ) be L-Lipschitz maps with H_j → H₀ uniformly on ℝ^m. Let w ∈ L¹(ℝ^m) (Lebesgue) and let ω : ℝ^{N'} → Λ^m(ℝ^{N'}) be a continuous m-form with compact support (DifferentialForm (Euclid N') m). Write DH(u) := fderiv ℝ H u and e_a for the standard basis of ℝ^m. Then ∫ w(u)·ω(H_j(u))(DH_j(u)e_0, …, DH_j(u)e_{m−1}) du → ∫ w(u)·ω(H₀(u))(DH₀(u)e_0, …, DH₀(u)e_{m−1}) du as j → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (m N' : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (H : ℕ → Euclid m → Euclid N') (H₀ : Euclid m → Euclid N') (w : Euclid m → ℝ) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') m), (∀ j, LipschitzWith L (H j)) → LipschitzWith L H₀ → TendstoUniformly H H₀ atTop → Integrable w → Continuous ω → HasCompactSupport ω → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ u, w u * ω (H j u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ (H j) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ u, w u * ω (H₀ u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ H₀ u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))))
